3. It is contended by learned counsel for 
petitioner that petitioner has retired from 
respondent No.3-Union Bank of India on 
30.03.2020. He was paid an amount of 
Rs.25,59,315/- along with interest. But the 
grievance of petitioner is that he has not 
been paid remaining amount of 
Rs.7,96,603/- of the gratuity, hence, he is 
before this Court seeking the said amount 
with interest.
4. Learned counsel for petitioner submits 
that petitioner has got legal and statutory 
rights to get gratuity and the respondent￾Bank cannot dwell the gratuity which has 
not been paid to petitioner.
5. Learned counsel for respondent No.3-
Bank prays for and is granted a week’s 
time to get instruction in the matter as to 
why the remaining amount has not been 
paid to petitioner or to make a statement 
before this Court that the remaining 
amount has now been paid to petitioner.
6. Put up as fresh on 09.06.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
